text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder finished the race with a 
brilliant result.

However, she was still hung up on the fact 
that she wasn't able to compete against 
Maruzensky.

After the race, Seiun Sky comes over and 
tells Grass Wonder, "Not even having you 
consider me as a rival honestly hurts a 
bit."

Those words made Grass Wonder realize that 
she hadn't been taking her matches against 
them seriously.
